name: Stihl
label: Stihl
summary: Stihl chain is sold through authorized dealers rather than online, so most replacement buying runs through Oregon-equivalent loops matched on pitch, gauge and drive links. Stihl's own designations — such as 61 PMM3 for the Picco Micro Mini 3 low-profile chain — are listed on each saw page next to the cross-references we could verify. Where a saw is read from STIHL's own chain-selection chart (the one we could read is dated 2017), the page says so.
